scripts.dev: node scripts/prisma-cli.mjs prisma migrate deploy && tsx watch src/index.ts
scripts.dev:e2e: cross-env NODE_ENV=development AGENT_PROVIDER=mock ENABLE_DEMO_CONTROLS=true DATABASE_URL=file:./e2e.db node scripts/prisma-cli.mjs prisma migrate reset --force && cross-env NODE_ENV=development AGENT_PROVIDER=mock ENABLE_DEMO_CONTROLS=true DATABASE_URL=file:./e2e.db tsx watch src/index.ts
scripts.test: cross-env NODE_ENV=test AGENT_PROVIDER=mock DATABASE_URL=file:./test.db node scripts/prisma-cli.mjs prisma migrate deploy && cross-env NODE_ENV=test AGENT_PROVIDER=mock DATABASE_URL=file:./test.db vitest run
